top_signals.title: Rakuten Credit Risk Surges After Yen Bond Offering Scrapped
top_signals.summary: Rakuten Group Inc.’s credit risk surged by the most since April 2025 after the company scrapped plans to raise about ¥150 billion ($942 million) in the bond market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Houthi attack on Saudi Arabian sovereign wealth fund PIF's tower injures 11
top_signals.summary: This has been the second attack by the Iran-backed group in six days on the tower, although the previous attack did not cause any casualties.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
